sections.shortTitle: DETENTION OF ENEMY SHIPS AIRCRAFT AND GOODS REPEAL ORDINANCE 1972
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

THE DETENTION OF ENEMY SHIPS, AIRCRAFT AND GOODS (REPEAL) ORDINANCE,
1972
THE DETENTION OF ENEMY SHIPS, AIRCRAFT AND GOODS (REPEAL) ORDINANCE,
1972
ORDINANCE NO. 11 OF 1972
[22nd January, 1972]
An Ordinance to repeal the Detention of Enemy Ships, Aircraft and Goods Ordinance, 1971
WHEREAS it
is expedient to repeal the Detention of Enemy Ships, Aircraft and Goods
Ordinance, 1971, XXXIII of 1971..
NOW
THEREFORE, in pursuance of the Proclamation of the 25th day of
March, 1969, read with the Proclamation of the 20th day of December, 1971, and
the Provisional Constitution Order, and in exercise of all powers enabling him
in that behalf, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the following
Ordinance :‑
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Detention of
Enemy Ships, Aircraft and Goods (Repeal) Ordinance, 1972.
(2)
It shall come into force at once.
